command: set -eu; SVC=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; PID=$(systemctl --user show "$SVC" -p MainPID --value); STATE=$(systemctl --user is-active "$SVC"); RAW=$(systemctl --user show "$SVC" -p ExecStart --value); echo "PID=$PID"; echo "STATE=$STATE"; echo "EXEC=$RAW"; echo '===RECENT==='; journalctl --user -u "$SVC" --since '-10 min' --no-pager -n 80 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===WORLD_MODULES_IN_PROCESS==='; if [ -r "/proc/$PID/maps" ]; then grep -E 'omega_(voice_world_patch|world_turn|world_model|grf_field)' "/proc/$PID/maps" || true; fi
